title: AHB Two-Cycle ERROR Response
description: Inspect why ERROR first stalls the pipeline and then completes the failed transfer, giving the master an opportunity—but not an unconditional requirement—to cancel the following address.

annotations.message: Address A is accepted. Its response will be observed later in A's data phase.
The pipeline broadcasts following address B while transfer A occupies the data phase.
ERROR cycle 1: HRESP=ERROR and HREADY=0 extend A for one cycle so the master can react to the already-broadcast B transfer.

ERROR cycle 2: HRESP remains ERROR and HREADY=1 completes failed transfer A. The cancel path drives IDLE and discards pending B; continuing the burst is also permitted, as shown by the separate path that keeps a legal SEQ transfer.
The bus returns to OKAY. A verifier must attribute both ERROR cycles to data phase A, not to following address B.
